recent_posts.title: Building Open Source CSPM with CloudQuery, PostgreSQL and Grafana
recent_posts.summary: CloudQuery is an open source tool for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) CSPM is built on top of Grafana, a popular BI and visualization tool. CSPMs are implemented in pure SQL and store results in a single table that you can easily query.

recent_posts.title: Deploying CloudQuery into an AWS Organization
recent_posts.summary: CloudQuery makes fetching resources from your entire organization simple as long as you have the proper IAM trust relationships and permissions setup. In this blog post we will walk through one way of setting up these permissions so that you can have access to all of your configuration data in a single queryable database.

recent_posts.title: How to Build Open Source Cloud Asset Inventory with CloudQuery and Microsoft Power BI
recent_posts.summary: In this blog post we show you how to build an open-source cloud asset inventory with CloudQuery as the ETL (Extract-Transform-Load) / data-ingestion layer and Microsoft Power BI as the visualization platforms. This approach eliminates the yet-another-dashboard fatigue and gives you the ability to pick the best-in-class visualization tools.

recent_posts.title: How To Run CloudQuery with PostgREST
recent_posts.summary: In this blog post, we will walk you through how to setup CloudQuery to build your cloud asset inventory in Postgres. We will also build a fully automated Restful API query layer with PostgREST to build custom use cases on top from search to security, cost and infrastructure automation.

recent_posts.title: CloudQuery raises $15M to rebuild the cloud security stack
recent_posts.summary: CloudQuery is an open source EL[T] platform focused on cloud infrastructure. It has a pluggable architecture that supports more than 1000 resources across all the major cloud providers and other infrastructure providers. At the time of writing there are more than 300 services in AWS with more than 1400 describe APIs.

recent_posts.title: Terraform Drift Deprecation
recent_posts.summary: This is a short note that v0.27.0 is deprecating Terraform drift functionality. This kind of mapping is useful for more than just detecting drift but also for other use-cases. We are going to give it another short in future releases once CloudQuery get to a more mature place.

recent_posts.title: How to expose CloudQuery with PostGraphile
recent_posts.summary: In this blog post, we will walk you through how to setup CloudQuery to build your cloud asset inventory in Postgres. We will also build a GraphQL API query layer with PostGraphile on top of it. this can be used to build different use cases on from search to security, cost and infrastructure automation.

recent_posts.title: How to Build Open Source Cloud Asset Inventory with CloudQuery and Google Data Studio
recent_posts.summary: In this blog post we show you how to build an open-source cloud asset inventory with CloudQuery as the ETL (Extract-Transform-Load) / data-ingestion layer and Google Data Studio as the visualization platforms. In this tutorial we will connect to publicly accessible RDS with authorized Data Studio IP addresses. You can reuse Data Studio to export/share those reports.

recent_posts.title: How to Setup Cross Account Access in AWS with AssumeRole
recent_posts.summary: In this blog we will walk through how to create a role an external account that we want to AssumeRole into. In our example we will provide the new role in the external account with broad ReadOnly permissions (but you are free to change to whatever you want)

recent_posts.title: Open Source Cloud Asset Inventory with Yevgeny Pats @ Software Engineer Daily
recent_posts.summary: Yevgeny Pats is the creator of CloudQuery, an open-source cloud asset inventory. CloudQuery allows you to ingest and structure the resources in your cloud accounts. This allows SRE teams to understand the source of specific resources, while security teams can ensure compliance with policies.

top_posts.title: AWS, Log4j and Finding Unrestricted Outbound Access
top_posts.summary: How to find resources unrestricted outbound with CloudQuery open-source cloud asset inventory. The Log4jshell (log4j) vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) emphasized more than ever the importance of setting network controls & policies not only on inbound traffic but also on outbound traffic.

top_posts.title: Announcing CloudQuery History
top_posts.summary: CloudQuery History adds TimescaleDB support to give users the ability to track their complete cloud asset inventory snapshots over time. All current CloudQuery features such as policies and providers continue to work seamlessly and get out-of-the-box support for historical snapshots. CloudQuery History provides full historical snapshots of your cloud assets.
